reason: I earn maybe $1,800 a month, and my clients will not pay extra for this, so $19 or $45 comes straight out of my pocket. My clients also hand me a bag of crumpled nota at month end, not Telegram photos, so I would still be photographing everything myself and then retyping it into Jurnal.
objection: Who pays? I cannot charge clients more for it, and with no export to Jurnal or Accurate it is just one more sheet I have to copy over by hand.
would_change_my_mind: A direct import into Jurnal or Accurate, at a price per account under about $10 a month that covers all my clients, not per client.
